country_profile.parameter_policy: Independent national inference and draws; shared biological priors retained unless evidence supports differences

mortality.required: National age- and case-definition-matched fatality and ascertainment evidence

extrapolation.interpretation: Deaths apply the separately calibrated Australian and English conditional course risks to nationally modelled onsets. This is a declared method extrapolation, not national fatality evidence. Each source is reported separately at its own published infant age boundary and is never pooled, averaged or reconciled; the risk-independent mortality_rank_bounds remain the evidence that does not depend on this assumption.

country_profile.test_interpretation: Prior predictive migration and sensitivity test; not calibrated burden estimates or posterior strategy probabilities
country_profile.context: wP primary series; maternal programme since 2014; 2016–2025 official confirmed-case age likelihood including monthly infant ages

national_policy.citation: Ministry of Health: maternal dTpa introduced in 2014, from 20 weeks gestation

migration_assumption.citation: Exploratory scenario assumption; uptake levels are not observed national estimates; nominal monthly spacing for Japan doses 2–3

age_case_source_verification.citation: Independent checks of official national age and month cells with original-file SHA256; 2026-10-27

short_wp.interpretation: Prespecified shared-prior quantile sensitivity, not a national estimate

long_wp.interpretation: Prespecified shared-prior quantile sensitivity, not a national estimate

observation.date_basis: calendar notification month; age at symptom onset/diagnosis
observation.source_status_note: 2016–2022 FINAIS; 2023–2025 PRELIM. Notification-delay medians 10–14 days; not onset-date observations.

assumptions: Future uptake in the inherited programme is a projection assumption, not an observation
Shared passive-protection clinical mechanism is conditional; country effectiveness has not been fitted
Fixed additional doses are 20 per 1000 annual births; this is not an equal-cost comparison

candidate_starts: new prior draws screened using training objective only
selection: training posterior objective; held-out outcomes not used for selection
